name: simplicity
description: Session ergonomics for Claude Code: /simplicity:just-ask collects every open question in the session and asks them through AskUserQuestion with a recommended option and reasoning; /simplicity:just-move prepares a session to run unattended: it asks every open decision and blocker up front, fixes what it can once you agree, and schedules a resume for after your usage limit resets; /simplicity:just-say-it re-states the latest response(s) as a short plain-language numbered list, or explains a commit, PR, document or pasted snippet the same way with no technical jargon; /simplicity:what-now takes stock of the session and lists what's done, where the current task stands and the next steps; /simplicity:just-finish-it pushes this session's work, merges the PRs whose CI is green, runs /simplicity:cleanup and archives the session, or reports what's still pending; /simplicity:shift-session commits and pushes the work, updates the trackers, hands it to a fresh child session and closes this one, and a hook suggests it once context use reaches a threshold; /simplicity:call-it-a-day puts the session on hold at the end of the day: it commits and pushes the work in progress, updates the trackers, saves a handoff note to memory, renames the session "<topic> -> On hold" and prints a handoff prompt, and the session gets its old title back when the work resumes; /simplicity:cleanup runs an end-of-session closing checklist; /simplicity:rename-session renames the session after what it was actually about; /simplicity:promptfy rewrites a prompt into a stronger one and hands it back without running it.
